"""Camera-guided controller; no environment state or reset access."""
import os,json,time,socket,traceback
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from rcb_client import Robot
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras']); counter=0
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
def state(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
def save(label):
 global counter
 counter+=1; path=f'/app/runs/{counter:03d}_{label}';obs.save(path)
 out=Image.new('RGB',(640,480))
 for i,c in enumerate(cams):
  im=Image.fromarray(obs.last[c]);ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((3,3),c.replace('robot0_',''),fill='red');out.paste(im,((i%2)*320,(i//2)*240))
 out.save('/app/output/latest.jpg');print('SAVED',path,flush=True)
def report():
 p=state();print('base',p[:4],'q',p[4:11],'grip',p[11:13],'eef',p[26:29], 'remaining',obs.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
def act(q=None,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,seconds=1,label='move'):
 global obs
 p=state(); start=p[29:36];q=start if q is None else np.array(q)
 n=max(1,round(seconds/.05)); A=np.zeros((n,13));A[:,:7]=np.linspace(start,q,n);A[:,7]=p[36] if grip is None else grip;A[:,12]=-1
 if base is not None:A[:,8:11]=base;A[:,12]=1
 A[:,11]=torso
 with open('/app/output/actions.jsonl','a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'actions':A.tolist()})+'\n')
 obs=r.submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none',note=label);save(label);report()
def observe(label='observe',seconds=0):
 global obs
 obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none',seconds=seconds);save(label);report()
def point(cam,u,v):
 c=cams[cam] if isinstance(cam,int) else cam;d=np.asarray(obs.depth[c]).squeeze();z=float(d[v,u]);K=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][c]['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][c]['cam2world_gl']);return T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z])
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for a,xyz,rx in zip(q,[(0,0,.333),(0,0,0),(0,-.316,0),(.0825,0,0),(-.0825,.384,0),(0,0,0),(.088,0,0)],[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]):
  U=np.eye(4);U[:3,3]=xyz;U[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('x',rx).as_matrix()@Rot.from_euler('z',a).as_matrix();T=T@U
 return T
save('start');report()
sock=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);sock.bind('/app/output/control.sock');sock.listen(1)
while True:
 conn,_=sock.accept();data=b''
 while True:
  v=conn.recv(65536)
  if not v:break
  data+=v
 code=data.decode();open('/app/output/commands.pylog','a').write(code+'\n')
 try:exec(code,globals());conn.sendall(b'OK')
 except Exception:traceback.print_exc();conn.sendall(traceback.format_exc().encode())
 conn.close()
